review: Captain Ishmael is a very interesting Support ID. Very good and strong, a lot of going on in her kit but she has issues in her design that make her finicky to use and team build around. Let’s focus on good things first. Skill 1 rolls 12 with +3 offense level which is already above average. On top of that, S1 buffs Defense Level, grants aggro, and at any 4+ A-Resonance, grants 1 Protection. This offers small, but decent damage reduction for an ally adjacent to her on the board. Skill 2 rolls 16 with 48 offense, which is average but this skill offers 3 Offense Level Up to 2 allies adjacent to her on board (Equals to 1 clash power), at 4+ highest A-Resonance grants 2 Damage Up AND at 4+ Pride A-Resonance, grants 2 Pride Power Up. All those buffs can boost damage, especially when skills are of the Pride Sin affinity. On top of it all, with high enough Resonance, S2 will activate Assist Attac
